description: University of Rhode Island Photovoltaic Battery Energy Storage SOC Tracking Dataset (URI-PBEST) is a data set described in the paper "University of Rhode Island Photovoltaic Battery Energy Storage SOC Tracking Dataset (URI-PBEST)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2026), produced by Showrov Rahman, Kaushallya Adhikari, Kaan Icer. Battery energy storage systems (BESSs) have emerged as a premier energy storage solution due to their modular architecture, decreasing costs, and increasing energy densities. These systems are increasingly integrated with photovoltaic (PV) arrays to mitigate energy wastage and enable sophisticated energy management. However, the operational environment and charging/discharging profiles of a PV-BESS differ significantly from other applications that also deploy BESSs, such as electric vehicles (EVs). Coverage: a photovoltaic battery storage system at the University of Rhode Island. The data are held on Zenodo, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost: free of charge according to the repository record; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support battery energy storage state-of-charge estimation with photovoltaics. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
